description: The sequence of side lengths that occur when drawing a sequence of squares in the plane with integer side lengths such that the bottom-left corner of the k-th square is at the nonnegative integer point (k, y_k) and the square has side length a(k), subject to the conditions that (1) every initial segment has the property that the interior of each square has a distinct pattern made by the perimeters of the other squares, and (2) we greedily minimize the side length and then minimize the y-value.
